concepts.meaning: An ordering constraint active only between compensation occurrences selected from confirmed completed forward steps.
An authored ordering edge whose target compensation is not needed after a known partial failure; retained as evidence but not scheduled.
A bounded caller-supplied confirmed source prefix and immediately following non-committed or indeterminate step; not durable provider evidence.
Planning is not evaluated while a forward commit is unknown; no immutable Recovery Intent has been created.

distinctions: ordering is not mandatory business eligibility
no ordering constraint is not parallel execution
confirmed source prefix is not arbitrary completed set
candidate intent is not dispatched recovery
deterministic invocation identity is not durable replay protection
